question: A coil has $N$ turns and each turn has area $A$. It is placed in a uniform magnetic field $B$ such that the normal to the coil makes an angle $\theta$ with the field. Obtain an expression for the induced emf if the magnetic field changes uniformly from $B_1$ to $B_2$ in time $\Delta t$, while the coil remains fixed.
